rationale: Two designs fit the need and the choice between them depends on a fact outside the team's control. A pathway compliance audit against the standard can run now on ambulance records (claim c1), with timing as part of the standard (claim c2). A linked retrospective outcome analysis would answer whether early treatment helps here, but only with a renewed agreement covering all three hospitals, because partial linkage misses older, sicker and transferred patients (claim c3). Recommending either family now would be a guess.
alternatives: Pathway compliance audit from ambulance records only
Retrospective linked outcome analysis once the agreement is renewed
Compliance audit now, outcome analysis later as a separate study
guidelines: RECORD if linked data are later used
whyNotMoreComplex: A prospective registry or a trial of pathway changes would need resources and approvals the network does not have; the first question is whether the pathway is followed.

decision.statement: Defer the choice between a compliance audit alone and a linked outcome analysis until the data-sharing agreement is renewed; meanwhile, agree the audit standard and data dictionary with the ambulance service's audit team.
decision.question: Which design should the network use to examine its pre-hospital tranexamic acid pathway?

criteria.text: Compliance in comparable rural services is incomplete, so an audit is likely to find missed or late doses worth acting on.
Linkage would capture enough transferred and older patients to make an outcome analysis credible.

gates.requirement: Ambulance service clinical audit committee approval for the pathway audit
gates.evidence: Audit committee approval CA-EMS-2026-22 dated 14 August 2026, supplied by the investigator

gates.requirement: A data-sharing agreement between the ambulance service and all three hospitals covering linkage of patient care records to hospital outcomes
gates.evidence: Agreement DSA-2023-04 expired on 30 June 2026 and has not been renewed, supplied by the investigator

alternatives: Compliance audit only, with no outcome question
Wait for the agreement before doing anything
decision.note: The family is left unresolved on purpose; the unmet agreement blocks action on the decision.

summary: No family recommended until the data-sharing agreement is renewed; one gate met, one unmet.
